refusals.message: `Object.setPrototypeOf`, which is prototype and descriptor reflection: a value's shape is fixed when it is laid out, so there is no prototype object to hold a property, no descriptor to redefine one with, and nothing that can be given a different shape at run time is not supported by this lowering yet

the initializer of `z` was not compiled because it calls `bad`, which was refused above; the rest of the module's evaluation still runs

`f` cannot be compiled because it reads `first`, which a module statement evaluation skips would have assigned
